class.name: EquipmentDefinition
class.brief_description: What putting an item on does to the pawn.
class.description: Abilities granted, effects and loose tags held while it is on, and scenes shown. Referenced from an item by [InventoryFragmentEquippableItem], or equipped directly with [method EquipmentManagerComponent.equip_item]. Like item definitions, one that should reach clients must be a saved resource.

members.member: [GameplayAbility] templates granted on the server through the pawn's [AbilitySystemComponent] and taken back on unequip. The item instance is their source object.
[GameplayEffect]s applied while equipped and removed on unequip.
Loose gameplay tags held while equipped, e.g. [code]State.Equipped.Axe[/code].
A script extending [EquipmentInstance], for equip and unequip logic of its own. Empty means a plain [EquipmentInstance].
